Good questions.

Are there vegan options?

Yuzu and peach sorbets are vegan example recipes. Matcha and chilli chocolate have vegan variations. Always check with the maker.

Can I order for delivery?

This concept is a come-to-us kind of place. The cup builder is a local planner and sends no order.

What about allergies?

Shared equipment handles dairy, eggs, nuts and gluten. Cross-contact is possible. Speak to a real maker before consuming.

Do you supply restaurants?

Wholesale would require a direct conversation about capacity, delivery and minimum orders. The enquiry below is only a local preview.
